description: 西西里四马变 B45 — 抢占c线主动权

intro.popup_en:
Open Files, Practice 6: Fight for the c-File
White has already placed a rook on c1. Black needs to challenge it with ...Rc8. On an open file, the side that occupies it first usually takes the initiative. Can Black contest the c-file in time?
intro.popup:
抢占c线主动权 练习6

白方Rc1已占c线！
黑方必须立刻Rc8反压

开放线上的争夺：
谁先占谁主动！
黑方能否在c线上反制？

outro.popup_en: Summary: ...Bxc3+ creates doubled c-pawns, then the exchanges on d5 open the c-file completely. White takes the file first with Rc1. On an open file, the slower side becomes passive; Black needed to challenge it immediately with ...Rc8.
outro.popup:
c线争夺小结
✅ Bxc3+：黑方主动造c叠兵
✅ exd5 exd5：c线完全打通
✅ Rc1先手：白方抢c线

关键要点：
开放线上谁慢谁被动
黑方需Rc8立刻反压！

moves.popup_en: e4 opens the game.
...c5 begins the Sicilian Defense and creates a semi-open c-file.
moves.popup:
c5！西西里
c线半开放线诞生

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops.
...Nc6 develops.
d4 counterattacks in the center.
...cxd4 exchanges pawns and opens the c-file.
Nxd4 recaptures and occupies the center.
...Nf6 develops.
Nc3 develops.
...e6 reinforces Black's position and enters the Four Knights Variation.
Ndb5 maneuvers the knight and threatens d6.
...Bb4 pins the knight and prepares to exchange it on c3.
a3 challenges the bishop as White tries to preserve Nc3.
moves.popup:
a3逼象
白方试图保住c3马

moves.popup_en: ...Bxc3+! Black exchanges and removes the knight, leaving White with doubled c-pawns that may become targets on the c-file.
moves.popup:
Bxc3+！黑方主动兑换！
消灭c3马
白方c列将出现叠兵！

moves.popup_en: Nxc3 recaptures with the knight, but the doubled c-pawns make the c-file easier to exploit.
moves.popup:
Nxc3马重建
但c3叠兵后c线更容易被利用

moves.popup_en: ...d5! Black counterattacks in the center and fights for the initiative.
moves.popup:
d5！中心反击！
黑方争夺中心主动

moves.popup_en: exd5 exchanges pawns.
...exd5 recaptures, opening the d- and c-files further.
moves.popup:
exd5黑方回吃
d线和c线进一步打开！

moves.popup_en: Bd3 develops the bishop.
O-O secures White's king.
...O-O secures Black's king.
...Re8 activates Black's rook on the e-file and keeps the position flexible.
moves.popup:
Re8！黑车占e线
守护e列，灵活机动

moves.popup_en: Bg5 develops the bishop and pressures Nf6.
...Be6 develops the bishop and supports d5.
Rc1! White claims the c-file first. Rc3 or Rc5 may follow to increase pressure. Black needs to challenge the file immediately with ...Rc8 before White's advantage grows.
moves.popup:
Rc1！白方抢占c线！
先手！车来c1
下一步Rc3或Rc5威胁黑方

黑方必须立刻Rc8反压！
否则白方c线优势将扩大！
